title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
title_es: Agente de IA personal accedió a sistema seguro del Pentágono
bajada: Un empleado de Accenture ejecutó su agente Claude personal en una red del Departamento de Defensa durante dos meses antes de ser detectado. El incidente expone riesgos críticos de seguridad en entornos gubernamentales.
bajada_en: An Accenture employee's personal Claude agent ran on a DoD network for two months before detection. The incident reveals critical security risks in government environments.

title: Behind DeepSeek’s $16 Billion Funding: Chinese Tech Titans and State Players
summary: Chinese AI star DeepSeek’s nearly $16 billion funding round this month involved not only a deluge of capital but a who’s who of Chinese tech investors—and some of the country’s most powerful state-backed institutions, according to details of the round obtained by The Information.It was only the second fundraising round for DeepSeek. The three-year-old company was the only major AI model developerto eschew external capitaluntil its first fundraising in April. The new round included previous backers—Tencent and battery maker CATL continue to be DeepSeek’s top two investors—but also other tech companies including notably memory chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies and its chairman Zhu Yiming, according to the details provided by two people with direct knowledge of the matter.
title_es: DeepSeek recauda $16 mil millones con apoyo de gigantes chinos
bajada: DeepSeek completó su segunda ronda de financiación con $16 mil millones, involucrando a gigantes tech chinos y organismos respaldados por el estado. La ronda consolida a China como potencia en desarrollo de modelos de IA.
bajada_en: DeepSeek closed a $16 billion funding round involving Chinese tech giants and state-backed institutions. The round solidifies China as a powerhouse in AI model development.

title: Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
summary:
Hi HN, we're Ahnaf and Seungmin from Simantic (https://simantic.com). We are building the simulation layer that lets engineers and AI agents test and validate firmware without hardware.Before Simantic, we were ex-firmware engineers at companies like Neuralink and Tesla. We’ve worked on some of the coolest projects, like the Cybertruck and Roadster, back when they were still early prototypes.We started working on firmware back when ChatGPT didn’t exist yet, but over the years, we saw how much of the engineering and development work has been automated as the frontier models improved to this point. In software, AI can run and test code inside your computer in a matter of seconds. But as firmware engineers, we didn’t have that luxury. An AI agent can write firmware in seconds, but in order to test it, we had to flash a physical board, then manually run tests using expensive and clunky tools with software made over a decade ago.To speed up the validation loop, we built the simulation layer that lets AI agents test the firmware and make decisions based on evidence, instead of waiting for the engineer to run tests for them. We used to spend hours testing our firmware manually on devboards, but now we use our own simulation to validate firmware in seconds.What we offer:
- Virtual devboards you can program and run with a single API call, without leaving your terminal.
- An AI code reviewer for firmware, that makes informed decisions based on evidence, using our simulation as a verification engine.
- A CI/CD pipeline for your hardware projects that validates your firmware against a simulated version of the microcontroller on every commit.Here is a demo of our simulation used in an AI code review session:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kBK1ZjGWWbQOur users are using Simantic for bare-metal and RTOS development for applications like flight controllers, electric vehicles, robotics, and satellites. title_es: Simantic: plataforma de simulación de firmware para agentes IA
bajada: Ex-engineers de Neuralink y Tesla lanzaron Simantic, una herramienta que permite a agentes de IA probar firmware sin hardware físico. La solución acelera ciclos de validación en desarrollo de sistemas embebidos.
bajada_en: Former Neuralink and Tesla engineers launched Simantic, a tool enabling AI agents to test firmware without physical hardware. The solution accelerates validation cycles in embedded systems development.

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI

El documento es relevante para developers que construyen aplicaciones con estos modelos.
bajada_en: OpenAI released an updated Model Spec defining five core values to guide more capable AI models toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to user intent. The document is relevant for developers building applications with these models.
